cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a rooftop open-air listening lounge at dusk with a low sofa and an urban skyline — leaning forward to listen closely to a vinyl record while holding its plain inner sleeve on her knees; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — dries her hair with a towel; a quiet sleeper-train compartment at sunrise — waking slowly and stretching a soft slipper toward the floor while listening to music from a small speaker; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; an open-air hot spring among steaming rocks — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — chest-deep in the water; a Guan Yu temple — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a narrow city alley with hanging signboards and wet pavement — carries a camera by its grip at her side
